name: 道の駅 香春
desc: 福岡県香春町の国道322号沿いにある道の駅「香春」。小説『青春の門』の舞台となった香春岳の麓に位置し、石灰石の採掘で平らになった一ノ岳の雄大な姿を間近に望めるのが最大の特徴です。直売所「わぎえの里」には、地元農家の朝採れ野菜をはじめ、名産の柿やたけのこ、手作り惣菜などが豊富に並びます。豊かな自然とノスタルジックな歴史の息吹を感じながら、地元の美味を堪能できる憩いのスポットです。
descEn: Located along Route 322 in Kawara Town, Fukuoka Prefecture, Roadside Station "Kawara" is situated at the foot of Mt. Kawara, the setting for the famous novel "Seishun no Mon" (The Gate of Youth). Its greatest feature is the spectacular close-up view of the mountain's majestic peaks, particularly the uniquely flat-topped First Peak, which was altered by limestone mining. The farmers' market, "Wagie no Sato," offers an abundance of local specialties, including morning-harvested vegetables, famous local persimmons and bamboo shoots, and handmade deli items. It is a relaxing spot where you can savor delicious local foods while feeling the breath of nostalgic history and abundant nature.
